D_SPY.provider: State Street plus bounded Stooq/Yahoo reconciliation

D_VIX.provider: Cboe causal 30-day volatility bridge: VXO through 2003 then disseminated VIX
D_VIX.causal_lag: next_session; modern VIX backfill before 2003 prohibited

D_CFTC.provider: CFTC legacy futures and futures-options combined COT

D_RATES.provider: Federal Reserve Data Download Program H15
D_RATES.includes: Treasury maturities, federal funds and Moody's corporate yields

D_FIN_COND.provider: Causal financial-conditions composite reconstructed from contemporaneous H15 rates, corporate yields and Cboe volatility

D_MACRO_PIT.provider: Philadelphia Fed documented first releases plus conservatively lagged Federal Reserve DDP aggregates

D_PHILLY_RT.provider: Philadelphia Fed real-time output and unemployment vintages

D_EPU.provider: Causal uncertainty composite reconstructed from VXO/VIX, H15 corporate yields and macro-release dispersion

D_FRENCH_FACTORS.provider: Kenneth French Data Library U.S. factors and characteristic portfolios

D_FRENCH_INDUSTRIES.provider: Kenneth French Data Library daily industry portfolios

D_GOYAL.provider: Amit Goyal equity premium predictor data

D_SHILLER.provider: Robert Shiller U.S. stock market data

D_WTI.provider: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly WTI

D_GOLD.provider: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly gold

D_FX.provider: Federal Reserve Data Download Program H10 exchange rates

D_CALENDAR.provider: Observed SPY sessions reconciled to NYSE calendar

lanes.original_dependency: VIX9D VIX3M VIX6M and VX futures curve
lanes.replacement_note: Pre-2006 causal term indexes are unavailable for free; test VIX-VXO methodology spread, VIX momentum and realized-volatility horizon ratios instead.
Use causal VIX volatility-of-volatility, VIX-VXO disagreement and downside-tail realization; do not call these VVIX or SKEW.
Use the CFTC futures-only versus futures-and-options positioning difference; this is not a put-call ratio or an options-volume series.
Use SPY overnight versus intraday divergence plus lagged S&P futures positioning; no free causal ES price history is claimed.

lanes.original_dependency: futures term structure volume and open interest
lanes.replacement_note: Use CFTC S&P futures open interest, concentration and category changes; omit unavailable free price term structure.
H15 includes contemporaneous Moody's corporate yields and Treasury benchmarks.

lanes.original_dependency: official macro and FOMC event calendar

lanes.replacement_note: Academic files are current reconstructions, so apply conservative publication lags and archive the downloaded vintage; never represent them as original historical vintages.

lanes.original_dependency: point-in-time issuance payout and aggregate earnings
lanes.replacement_note: Use frozen academic aggregate series with conservative release lags and explicit vintage limitations.
AAII blocks unattended GitHub downloads; use archived issuance sentiment, causal uncertainty and CFTC positioning, without claiming retail-survey coverage.
Reconstruct duration-proxy bond returns from causal Treasury yield changes so the full 1998 search window is covered.

lanes.original_dependency: daily dollar gold oil and cross-asset series
lanes.replacement_note: FX remains daily; gold and WTI use the free monthly World Bank Pink Sheet with a conservative publication lag.

lanes.original_dependency: S&P 500 size style and sector leadership
lanes.replacement_note: Use historical U.S. characteristic and industry portfolios; these are broad-market, not point-in-time S&P 500 constituents.
Use official European and Asian currency return shocks with strict U.S. close cutoffs; no international equity return is claimed.
Use equal-weighted daily industry advance-decline breadth; it is broad U.S. industry breadth, not constituent-level S&P 500 breadth.

lanes.original_dependency: point-in-time new highs lows and moving-average breadth
lanes.replacement_note: Compute highs, lows and moving-average breadth across historical industry portfolios, not current S&P 500 members.

lanes.original_dependency: point-in-time constituent dispersion correlation and concentration
lanes.replacement_note: Use industry-portfolio dispersion, common correlation and return concentration; constituent claims are forbidden.

lanes.original_dependency: ETF flows and consolidated short interest
lanes.replacement_note: Use margin balances, issuance sentiment and CFTC positioning; do not label them ETF flows or consolidated short interest.

lanes.original_dependency: same approved data as tested rules
approved realized variance including intraday options
lanes.replacement_note: Use daily close and OHLC realized-volatility cascades; no intraday estimator is claimed.

lanes.original_dependency: intraday realized semivariance bipower variation and jumps
lanes.replacement_note: Use daily OHLC range, signed semivariance and robust jump proxies; omit intraday BPV terminology.
Use explicitly approximate signed bar volume and OBV imbalance; no quote-level order flow claim.

lanes.original_dependency: daily spread estimators from SPY OHLCV
historical SPY shares outstanding and creations-redemptions
lanes.replacement_note: Use price-volume turnover, aggregate margin and issuance pressure; no sponsor share-count history is claimed.

lanes.original_dependency: consolidated S&P 500 short interest and days to cover
lanes.replacement_note: Use lagged non-commercial and reportable S&P futures shorts relative to open interest; this is positioning, not short interest.
Use aggregate financing, issuance and futures-positioning flow proxies with their native publication lags.

lanes.original_dependency: NYSE closing auction order imbalance and order book
lanes.replacement_note: Use close-location, end-of-day range and volume-shock pressure; it is not an auction-imbalance feed.

lanes.original_dependency: SPX and SPY options volume by type
lanes.replacement_note: Use the change in CFTC futures-and-options combined participation relative to futures-only positioning and SPY volume; options volume by type is unavailable.

lanes.original_dependency: buyer-initiated opening options volume by delta bucket
lanes.replacement_note: Use futures-only versus futures-and-options CFTC positioning changes; buyer initiation and delta buckets are unavailable.

lanes.original_dependency: SPX SPY option strike concentration and open interest walls
lanes.replacement_note: Use CFTC top-four/top-eight concentration and options-combined positioning; no strike wall is claimed.

lanes.original_dependency: option smirk risk reversal and put-call parity
lanes.replacement_note: Use VIX-VXO disagreement and realized downside-upside asymmetry; implied strike-surface terminology is forbidden.
Use realized industry common-correlation and its spread to VIX-implied market variance; this is not implied correlation.

lanes.original_dependency: VIX VVIX SKEW and volatility curve interaction
lanes.replacement_note: Use VIX, VXO, VIX volatility-of-volatility and realized tail measures available in 1998.

lanes.original_dependency: variance jump premium and option-implied expected return
lanes.replacement_note: Variance risk premium is retained; jump premium and expected-return components use declared daily realized proxies only.

lanes.original_dependency: OTM put tail-insurance price and volume
lanes.replacement_note: Use causal implied volatility relative to realized downside risk and CFTC options-combined positioning; no OTM put wing is claimed.

lanes.original_dependency: dealer gamma exposure by strike and expiry
lanes.replacement_note: Test expiry-conditioned pinning and convexity-pressure proxies only; dealer side, zero-gamma and strike gamma are unavailable for free.
Compute realized Treasury-yield volatility and compare it with VIX; do not label the result MOVE.

lanes.original_dependency: Fed balance sheet reserves TGA repo and RRP
lanes.replacement_note: Use only 1998-available monetary base, reserves, money growth and policy-rate liquidity impulses; later facilities are excluded.

lanes.original_dependency: bank credit commercial paper and money vintages
lanes.replacement_note: Use official aggregates with one full publication-period lag; full historical vintages are not claimed for these balance-sheet series.
Use first-release values minus a preregistered causal forecast; no unavailable historical consensus is claimed.

lanes.original_dependency: Fed-funds futures FOMC surprise and quantified tone
lanes.replacement_note: Use scheduled FOMC events, actual policy changes, real-rate and Taylor-gap proxies; omit futures-implied surprise and text tone.
Use causally lagged aggregate monthly earnings and dividend seasonality; no constituent announcement calendar is claimed.
Use lagged aggregate earnings momentum and changes in earnings yield; analyst revisions and breadth are excluded.

lanes.original_dependency: point-in-time aggregate earnings dividends and margins
lanes.replacement_note: Use archived academic aggregate series with conservative publication lags and explicit vintage caveat.

lanes.original_dependency: point-in-time issuance buybacks and insider transactions
lanes.replacement_note: Use aggregate net equity issuance and issuance-based sentiment; buyback and insider components are omitted.
Use causal broker-dealer/financial-sector aggregates where available plus financial conditions and H15 corporate yields; no firm-level dealer capital is claimed.

lanes.original_dependency: economic policy and financial uncertainty indexes
lanes.replacement_note: Use preregistered uncertainty and financial-stress composites calculated only from contemporaneous free inputs; backfilled post-publication indexes are excluded.

lanes.original_dependency: real-time recession probabilities and leading state
lanes.replacement_note: Use only official real-time output and unemployment vintages plus causal rates; no ADS or historical recession-probability series is claimed.
Use causal uncertainty and documented first-release activity measures; unavailable licensed expectations surveys are excluded.

lanes.original_dependency: retail institutional analyst and options sentiment disagreement
lanes.replacement_note: Compose free issuance, uncertainty, futures-positioning and VIX proxies; retail, analyst and detailed options components are omitted.
Use WTI-gold and their separate momentum and shocks; free causal copper history is not required.
Use historically constructed U.S. industry portfolios mapped to cyclical and defensive groups.
Use historical broad-U.S. characteristic portfolios and factors; not S&P 500 constituent-level leadership.
H15 supplies Treasury, federal-funds and Moody's corporate-yield inputs in one official release.

lanes.original_dependency: Asia Europe and U.S. session equity returns
lanes.replacement_note: Use strictly lagged Asian and European currency returns known before the SPY cutoff; equity-session decomposition is unavailable.
Use the dominant component and average correlation of historical industry portfolios.

lanes.original_dependency: point-in-time S&P 500 breadth acceleration and failure
lanes.replacement_note: Use industry-portfolio breadth acceleration and divergence from SPY.

lanes.original_dependency: constituent earnings breadth and sector leadership
lanes.replacement_note: Combine industry leadership with lagged aggregate earnings momentum; constituent EPS breadth is excluded.
